shared_or_similar_visual_information: A small square angle marker at the intersection of two lines
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It indicates that the vertical line from A to the horizontal axis is perpendicular to that axis, forming a right angle. Right image: It indicates that BC is perpendicular to the base AD, forming a right angle at C.
Rationales: Both small squares are explicit right-angle symbols; their colors and the solid or dashed styles of the attached lines do not change this meaning.
